newsitem.title: USA: HORSE RACING-SILVER CHARM WINS KENTUCKY DERBY.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-SILVER CHARM WINS KENTUCKY DERBY.

text.p: Silver Charm, the
California-based second choice, outdueled favoured Captain
Bodgit down the long Churchill Downs home stretch on Saturday
to win the 123rd running of the Kentucky Derby by a head.
Free House finished third in the first leg of thoroughbred
horse racing's Triple Crown.
Silver Charm, which went off at 4-1 in the betting, began
moving for the lead as the horses came around the the last
turn in the 1 1/4 mile, $1 million race for 3-year-olds.
Captain Bodgit challenged for the lead all the way down
the quarter-mile stretch as a crowd of 141,198 roared.
Ridden by Gary Stevens and trained by Bob Baffert, Silver
Charm had run second to Free House in last month's Santa Anita
Derby in California. His Derby victory was his fourth win in
seven starts.
Captain Bodgit, who has won in Florida and California, was
in position to win the race from behind, just as he did in the
Wood Memorial. But the game Silver Charm never allowed Captain
Bodgit to push in front as the two ran stride for stride to
the finish.
Free House, which went off at 10-1, had a share of the
early lead and held the edge until Silver Charm made his move
after the horses rounded the final turn.
